page.layout: One printed title page, centred. Black ink title lines at the top, a woodcut or engraved monogram ornament in the middle, and the imprint at the foot. A library stamp sits over the centre and is not transcribed. The print on the scan shows strong mirrored show-through from the reverse, which is not transcribed.
page.notes: The engraved monogram ornament in the centre of the page is not transcribed. The library stamp (Bayerische Staatsbibliothek München) is omitted. The small italic lines under "COLLOQUIA" and the imprint line are faint and only partly legible; the readings "ALTDORFII" and the date are uncertain and should be checked against the scan. Show-through from the reverse side is mirrored and has been left out.
